d:
At the UN General Assembly, tensions between the US and Iran remain high despite behind-the-scenes talks. Donald Trump has threatened further strikes on Iran, while Tehran has demanded an end to hostilities, sanctions and the US naval blockade.
Meanwhile, Gulf nations are pushing for de-escalation, as Saudi Arabia seeks alternative routes for its oil exports. With Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian set to address the UNGA, all eyes are on New York.
Watch LIVE as Hem Kaur Saroya tells the latest on the US-Iran standoff and UNGA diplomacy.
